place.title: Place {ref} (slide switch)
place.text: Push the slide switch {ref}'s 3 legs into column f, one leg per row: outer leg 1 into hole {hole.end1}, the middle leg into {hole.com} and outer leg 3 into {hole.end2}. The slider faces up.
place.tip: Outer leg 3 gets no wire: with the slider on that side the middle leg touches nothing, and the Pico reads 1.

why: {ref} is an on/off input that stays where you leave it. Slid toward leg 1 it joins its middle leg to ground, so the Pico reads 0; slid the other way the pin reads 1.

wire.ground: With {ref} slid toward this side, its middle leg (and the Pico pin) connect to ground, so the pin reads 0. Slid the other way, the Pico's internal pull-up makes it read 1.
